digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) management and indexing
propositions: ADR numbers 0001-0069 contain 17 duplicate numbers (affecting 22 ADR files) due to race conditions and stale-base merges, requiring renumbering of duplicates to 0070-0091
Marker files in docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN (content = filename) implement collision-proof monotonic numbering that produces add/add git conflicts for duplicates, preventing CI-race vulnerabilities
Cross-references to moved ADRs must be rewritten to point to new numbers, with slug-based disambiguation recorded in RENUMBERING.md and validated by check_adr_numbers.py
A generated docs/adr/README.md index and RENUMBERING.md mapping table document the old-to-new ADR migration and per-reference resolution tiers (slug-exact, topic-matched, ancestry, unresolved)
CI assertion scripts validate the bijection between ADR files and marker files, detect dangling adr/NNNN-slug references, and ensure no two markers share content
